en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small rural town surrounded by forests and fields. Detached wooden houses with light façades and dark roofs are scattered along winding roads. There are open meadows, patches of cultivated land, and dense tree clusters. No prominent monumental building stands out, and there is no visible coastline or mountains; the terrain is gently rolling countryside.
